faq.note: Still stuck? We reply within a few hours.

items.a: Every paid plan adds AI credits to your balance each month, worth 100% of what you pay ($1 = 10,000 credits). Unused monthly credits roll over up to a cap (160K on Lite, 300K on Starter, 600K on Pro). Need more? Buy a top-up pack at any time — purchased credits don't count toward the cap.

items.q: What's the difference between Lite, Starter and Pro?
items.a: Only the number of AI credits you get each month. Every paid plan includes exactly the same tools: the Security Auditor and Gas Saver AI agents, front-end hosting, 70+ web3 AI skills, cloud save, and more.

items.q: Are Remix credits refundable if the subscription ends?
items.a: Credits are non-refundable. When your subscription ends you retain access until the end of the current billing period.

items.q: What is the Free tier AI credit limit?
items.a: On the Free tier, AI usage is pay-as-you-go: top up credits, connect your own API key, or pick a paid plan to get fresh credits every month.

AI agents extend RemixAI with skills, MCP, and more. Every paid plan includes the Security Auditor agent, which reviews your contract for vulnerabilities, and the Gas Saver agent, which finds gas optimizations.
Yes, on every paid plan: generate a front-end for your contract with QuickDApp and host it on IPFS with a Remix subdomain. Contact us for custom domain and enterprise options.
